author: AtditC
body:
Hey. This is basically the same post as this one, but we decided to reboot it because Ingigo, the owner of the original post, left Patchi.

We have limited slots, and we are accepting around 10 people each week. (to keep the server alive).
We have some ground rules:
Griefing will result in an obvious ban on all Patchi services (including TS).
Be nice! We want to build a nice community 
Hacking will result in in a ban on all Patchi services.
And enjoy yourself! 
If you’d like to join, please fill this application:
Age:
Skype:
Why you would like to join:

The applications will be reviewed at the end of each week!
You will be messaged on Skype by one of our Patchi SMP staff members if you get accepted, with the IP.

A list of players which applied, and which are already whitelisted, such as Patchi SMP-Staff members, can be found here: http://p-smp.team-patchi.net/ (updated only at weekends)

Thank you,
Patchi.
